symptom: A chat could correctly avoid claiming green while gates were queued, yet later chats had no guaranteed mechanism to prove that the status was refreshed, that no out-of-band production write occurred, or that terminal evidence belonged to the current exact candidate.
root_cause: Delivery truth existed across GitHub, hosting, Supabase/provider readback and learning stores, but terminal language itself was not required to carry a current, canonical, auditable proof bundle spanning those authorities.
fix: Require a terminal proof bundle for every LIVE_PROVEN/LIVE & BEWEZEN/PRODUCTION_GREEN/FULFILLED evaluation.
Refresh exact candidate identity and gate state immediately before terminal claims.
Require direct production/provider mutation or audit authority evidence before asserting absence of production writes.
Treat prior exact-head evidence as superseded when the active candidate head advances.
Log every terminal evaluation and persist learning/prevention plus next-agent discoverability evidence.
